links.comparator_used: Model prior (LLM answering from its own knowledge) along a constraint gradient toward executed, validated code
links.outcome: Fabricated evidence, and trust properties (pinning, provenance, auditability, reproducibility) in variant calling
links.effect: No numbers in the abstract. Fabricated evidence is described as neutralised by execution. Trust properties climb monotonically toward validated execution. Dangerous misclassification is rare and model-invariant.
links.quote: First, dangerous misclassification is rare and model-invariant, a controlled precondition of the executed architecture rather than a frontier, while fabricated evidence is measurable and is neutralised by execution.

design_hint: constraint gradient toward validated code execution with fail-closed evidence contract
